news_report_basis: BBC Sport: loan with an obligation to buy for EUR 180m
Al Jazeera/Reuters and ITV: GBP 125m, a flat fee equalling the British record
BBC Sport (cited by Wikipedia): initial GBP 125m plus GBP 5m add-ons
Sky Sports: fixed GBP 117m, no add-ons
Inside World Football and Sky: GBP 116m guaranteed (Forest say add-ons could take it to GBP 130m)
Reuters via NST: up to EUR 125m plus EUR 10-15m add-ons
Citizen Digital/AFP and theScore: initial GBP 106m (EUR 125m) plus GBP 17m (EUR 20m) add-ons
